newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish 10-year spread vs Bund hits record low.
newsitem.headline: Spanish 10-year spread vs Bund hits record low.

text.p: Spain's 10-year bond yield spread versus the Bund fell to all-time low of 75 basis points on Tuesday, dealers said.
The previous record was set on Friday at 77 basis points.
After a weak opening, the Spanish market is recovering ground, with the long bond future trading nine basis points higher at 115.76 at 0945 GMT.
But dealers ruled out bigger gains ahead of Tuesday's U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting, whose decision on key money rates will be announced when Spanish market is closed.
